jobDetails.title: Group Director, Technical Program Management - Strategic Partnerships - AI Natives
jobDetails.description:
About the Role: Walmart is building an AI-powered future of Commerce and Enterprise. We are seeking a Group Director of Strategic Partnerships to lead Walmart’s most strategic foundation-model partnerships, including OpenAI and Anthropic.
This leader will own the end-to-end partner relationships across consumer and enterprise use cases, translating frontier AI capabilities into differentiated consumer experiences and enterprise advantage at Walmart scale. Operating at the intersection of Product, Global Technology, and commercial strategy, you will shape joint roadmaps, structure and negotiate complex agreements, and drive execution across the enterprise. You will be the central point of accountability for ensuring these partnerships create durable value for Walmart while meeting our requirements for security, governance, reliability, and customer trust.
What You’ll Do:
Partnership Strategy and Business Development:
  • Define and lead Walmart’s partnership strategy and multi-year roadmap with OpenAI and Anthropic, aligned to consumer product priorities, enterprise AI strategy, and Global Technology’s platform roadmap.
